title: Missing Data Source — Transcripts Unavailable
description: Meeting transcript service has been down for 6 hours. Chat and task data still flowing.
expected_behavior: System processes available sources, marks transcript-dependent decisions as 'partial evidence', shows degradation warning on dashboard

partial_decision.title: Migrate to GraphQL Federation
partial_decision.confidence_note: Reduced confidence due to missing transcript corroboration
evidence: Chat #architecture-decisions: Marcus mentioned 'we discussed GraphQL federation in today's meeting and the team agreed'
partial_decision.warning: This decision was referenced in chat but the original meeting transcript is unavailable. Confidence reduced by 35%.

title: Contradictory Decisions Across Sources
description: Monday's meeting transcript says 'Use PostgreSQL for analytics' but Wednesday's chat thread says 'Team agreed on ClickHouse for analytics'.

conflicting_decisions.decision: Use PostgreSQL with materialized views for analytics workloads
conflicting_decisions.speaker: Marcus Rodriguez
conflicting_decisions.context: During the analytics architecture review meeting

conflicting_decisions.decision: Migrate analytics to ClickHouse for better columnar performance
conflicting_decisions.speaker: Priya Patel
conflicting_decisions.context: Follow-up chat after benchmarking new data

expected_behavior: System detects semantic similarity between decisions, flags as CONFLICT, requires human resolution before generating actions
resolution_options: Keep Decision 1 (PostgreSQL) — the later chat discussion is a proposal, not a final decision
Keep Decision 2 (ClickHouse) — the chat reflects updated information from benchmarks
Merge — use ClickHouse for heavy analytics, PostgreSQL for operational reports
Escalate — flag for architecture review board decision

title: High-Impact Action Requiring Rollback
description: A previously confirmed decision to deprecate internal gRPC v1 endpoints needs to be rolled back because a critical downstream service was discovered that still depends on it.
rollback_trigger: Discovery of payment processing service still using gRPC v1 — deprecation would cause payment failures

rollback_action.reason: Critical dependency discovered: payment-processing-service v3.2.1 uses gRPC v1 for all transaction calls. Deprecating would cause immediate payment failures affecting ~$2M daily volume.
rollback_action.follow_up_decision: Re-evaluate gRPC v1 deprecation after payment service is migrated to v2 (estimated Q1 2027)

expected_behavior: System records rollback with full audit trail, preserves original confirmation evidence, creates new decision record linking to the rollback, sends notification to original confirmer

title: Delayed Data Source Recovery and Backfill
description: Task management system was down for 12 hours. When it recovers, 15 task updates need to be backfilled without creating duplicates.

timeline.event: D2A marks TASK source as DELAYED
D2A marks TASK source as MISSING (>4h)

expected_behavior: System handles outage gracefully: continues with available sources during downtime, backfills when source recovers, deduplicates against existing data, marks source health correctly throughout lifecycle
